en.tour.steps.familyKids.title: Family & kids mode
en.tour.steps.familyKids.body: Help your children grow into salah gently. Parents see only the five fard statuses and their child's stickers — no comparisons, no notes.
en.circles.common.offline: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
en.circles.gate.title: Sign in to continue
en.circles.gate.body: Family and partner circles need a signed-in account, so your family's profiles stay with you on every device. Guests can still join a group khatm.
en.circles.gate.tv: Sign in on your phone, then open this screen again.
en.circles.hub.title: Your circles
en.circles.hub.subtitle: Family, accountability partner and group khatm
en.circles.hub.emptyBody: Start a family circle, or join one with an invite code.
en.circles.hub.familyBody: Add your children with a nickname and birth year only, and help them build the habit of salah with stars and stickers.
en.circles.privacy.title: Private by design
en.circles.privacy.body: Circles share as little as possible: no leaderboards, no rankings and no comparisons between members. You choose a display name for each circle; your account name and email are never shown.
en.circles.invite.shareMessage: Join my circle on Munib Tracker with code {{code}}: {{url}}
en.circles.invite.expires: Valid until {{when}} · can be used once
en.circles.invite.error: Couldn't create an invite. Please try again.
en.circles.invite.qrA11y: QR code for the invite link
en.circles.join.title: Join a circle
en.circles.join.badCode: This link doesn't contain a valid invite code. Ask for a new one.
en.circles.join.invalid: This invite has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
en.circles.join.rateLimited: Too many tries. Please wait a while and try again.
en.circles.join.forbidden: This invite can't be used with this account.
en.circles.join.roleHint.family: As a family member you can see your children's fard salah status. Your own salah is never shared unless you choose to.
en.circles.join.roleHint.partner: Partners share only a quiet "done" for the day — never the goal itself.
en.circles.join.roleHint.khatm_group: Pick a part of the Qur'an to read and finish the khatm together.
en.circles.join.displayNameHint: Optional. Only members of this circle see it.
en.circles.settings.groupSub: Family, kids mode, partner and group khatm
en.circles.settings.hubSub: See every circle and join with a code
en.circles.settings.familySub: Child profiles, rewards and the parent view
en.circles.settings.kidsDevice: Link this device to a child
en.circles.settings.kidsDeviceSub: Scan the QR code from a parent's phone to turn on kids mode here
en.circles.settings.khatmProgressSub: When a part of your group khatm is completed

en.family.title: Family
en.family.subtitle: Help your children grow into salah, gently
en.family.searchKeywords: family kids children child parent kids mode teach salah reward stickers stars
en.family.tvSetup: Set up your family circle on your phone. This screen is view-only on TV.
en.family.create.title: Start your family circle
en.family.create.body: You'll be the parent who manages it. You can invite the other parent and add your children next.
en.family.create.name: Circle name
en.family.noChildren: No child profiles yet. Add a child to start.
en.family.shareMine: Share my fard salah status with my parents
en.family.shareMineHint: Only ✓ / – for the five fard salah. Off by default; you can turn it off any time.
en.family.leaveConfirmBody: You'll stop seeing this circle straight away. Anything you shared is removed after 30 days.
en.family.deleteConfirmBody: This deletes the circle, every child profile and all shared statuses now. It can't be undone.
en.family.restDayHint: Mark a rest day whenever your child needs a break — no reason is ever recorded.
en.family.digestEmpty: Nothing logged this week yet — every small step counts.
en.family.digestLearning: Learning mode: no expectations yet — every salah tried is a step.
en.family.bandHint.learning: Under 7: learning mode. Salah can be logged for practice, with no expectations.
en.family.bandHint.gentle: 7 to 12: gentle tracking with stars and stickers.
en.family.bandHint.graduate: 13 or over: kids mode isn't used — invite them with their own account instead.
en.family.privacy.title: What parents see
en.family.privacy.body: For each child, only whether each of the five fard salah was logged (✓ / –) and the child's own stickers. No notes, no qaza, no rankings, and no comparisons between children. A parent's own salah is never shared.
en.family.evidence.title: Why families pray together
en.family.evidence.q666: Qur'an 66:6 — protect yourselves and your families
en.family.evidence.q20132: Qur'an 20:132 — enjoin salah on your family and be patient in it
en.family.add.title: Add a child
en.family.add.nicknameHint: A first name or nickname. No surname needed.
en.family.add.birthYearHint: Only the year is stored — never a birth date.
en.family.add.error: Couldn't add the child profile. Please try again.
en.family.consent.title: Parental consent
en.family.consent.stored: We store only the nickname and birth year you enter, and the salah your child logs (✓ / –).
en.family.consent.visible: Only parents in this family circle can see your child's statuses. Nothing is shared with other children.
en.family.consent.device: Your child's device needs no email or password, and you can unlink it at any time.
en.family.consent.delete: You can delete the profile and all its data at any time.
en.family.consent.confirm: I'm this child's parent or guardian and I agree
en.family.reconsent.title: Please confirm consent
en.family.reconsent.body: The parent who created these child profiles has closed their account, so the profiles have moved to you: {{names}}. Please confirm parental consent to keep them, or delete them.
en.family.reconsent.deadline_one: If you don't confirm, they will be deleted in {{count}} day.
en.family.reconsent.deadline_other: If you don't confirm, they will be deleted in {{count}} days.
en.family.child.title: Child
en.family.child.notFound: This child profile couldn't be found.
en.family.child.deleteBody: The profile, its statuses, stickers and linked device are deleted immediately. This can't be undone.
en.family.device.title: Child's device
en.family.device.body: Show this QR code to your child's phone or tablet. Their camera opens the app in kids mode — no email or password.
en.family.device.linked: A device is linked. Linking again replaces it.
en.family.device.qrHint: Valid for 5 minutes and works once.
en.family.device.qrA11y: QR code to link your child's device
en.family.reward.title: Reward
en.family.reward.body: Set a real reward your child is working towards, like a park trip. Progress counts days with all five logged — a missed day never resets it.
en.family.graduation.title: Growing up
en.family.graduation.body: Around 13 your child can move to their own account. Maturity (bulugh) is the real marker, so you can allow it earlier. After they move, you no longer see their statuses unless they choose to share.
en.family.graduation.early: Allow moving to their own account now
en.family.graduation.available: Ready to move to their own account
en.family.invite.title: Invite to your family
en.family.invite.subtitle: Each code works once and expires after 7 days
en.family.invite.parentHint: They'll be able to manage the children's profiles with you.
en.family.invite.memberHint: They join with their own account and share nothing unless they choose to.
en.kids.title: Kids mode
en.kids.tvUnavailable: Kids mode works on a phone or tablet.
en.kids.notLinked: This device isn't linked to a child profile yet.
en.kids.pray.hint: Tap a salah when you've prayed it.
en.kids.pray.learningHint: Practice time! Tap a salah when you try it.
en.kids.pray.allFive: All five today — you earned a sticker!
en.kids.unlinkBody: Kids mode turns off on this device. A parent can link it again with a new QR code.
en.kids.graduate.offer: You're growing up! You can move to your own account.
en.kids.graduate.title: Your own account
en.kids.graduate.subtitle: Keep your place in the family circle
en.kids.graduate.notYet: Moving to your own account isn't available yet. Ask your parent.
en.kids.graduate.signIn: Sign in with your own account to continue.
en.kids.graduate.privacy: After you move, your parents no longer see your salah unless you turn sharing on.
en.kids.link.title: Link to a child profile
en.kids.link.subtitle: For a child's phone or tablet
en.kids.link.howTo: Ask your parent to open Family › Manage › Show QR code, then scan it with this device's camera. Or paste the code here.
en.kids.link.error: That code didn't work. It lasts 5 minutes and works once — ask for a new one.
en.kids.link.rateLimited: Too many tries. Please wait a few minutes.
en.kids.link.already: This device is already linked to a child profile.
en.kids.link.privacy: No email or password is used. A parent can unlink this device at any time.
